failure_modes.recovery: The error carries clarification: CLARIFICATION_NEEDED plus recovery[] steps — typically: ask the recipient principal to enable Cross-Tenant Communication under Network → Consent.
failure_modes.when: the recipient tenant has not granted cross_tenant_comm consent, or its claims narrow this call out, or either side is not KYB-approved

failure_modes.recovery: Fix the named field and retry.
failure_modes.when: to_tenant_id is missing, body is empty, or to_tenant_id is your own tenant (use intra-tenant surfaces for self-notes)

preconditions: Cross-tenant ONLY: to_tenant_id must be another tenant; the recipient principal must hold an active cross_tenant_comm consent grant.
Both tenants must be KYB-approved (verified-business-to-verified-business reach only).
The note lands in the RECIPIENT tenant's agent_note inbox; your identity is recorded server-side and cannot be spoofed.

description: Send a cross-tenant AI-to-AI message into another tenant's agent_note inbox — the door that turns a cross_tenant_comm consent grant into an actual reach. Both tenants must be KYB-approved and the recipient must hold an active grant (claims can narrow it further); every recipient-side failure refuses identically so the network can't be probed for who exists — only your OWN unapproved KYB answers distinctly, since that discloses nothing about the target. Your sender identity is injected server-side into from_tenant_id and cannot be spoofed. NEXT: agent_note_list on the recipient side confirms delivery.

to_tenant_id.description: The recipient tenant id — must be another tenant, never your own. The recipient must hold an active cross_tenant_comm consent grant and both tenants must be KYB-approved, or the door refuses uniformly without revealing which condition failed.

name: agent_note_send_cross_tenant
